verdict.rationale: Zapier's core model is event-triggered automation. Its docs describe triggers and actions, webhooks, polling triggers and Zap workflows. Community users confirm running trigger-to-action Zaps with multiple IFs and THENs, webhook-based automations and calendar-sync Zaps. Some engineers report weak escape hatches for custom conditional logic. Missing for 10: first-party end-user documentation of the Zap rule builder (filters, conditional paths, scheduling), and evidence of rich conditional logic given community complaints about its limits.
